description:
We are a team of Computer Science Engineering (Data Science) students from JNNCE, Shivamogga, and we are excited to take on the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.  

We are interested in the storytelling challenge about the hardware NASA has left on the Moon, Mars and in deep space. We want to turn it into an interactive experience that helps school students learn about these missions.

Our skills: web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), data handling, and design.
